verdict.rationale: Pulumi runs its own public Pulumi Registry with 316 packages, including AWS, Azure Native, Google Cloud and Kubernetes. Every supported language can consume registry providers, and the registry page invites users to "Contribute your own packages," which covers both consuming and publishing. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the publishing workflow, explicit evidence that reusable components (not just providers) are shared through the registry, and independent hands-on corroboration of publishing.
